pkgmetadata.longdescription: Hummingbird is a zero-dependency C17 runtime intended to run large open-source LLMs, both dense and Mixture-of-Experts, on consumer hardware by unifying SSD, RAM, and VRAM into a single managed memory hierarchy. As of this packaging the project is at an early "Phase 4" scaffolding stage: the build system, CLI, and server frontends exist, but inference, kernels, and model loading are not yet implemented.
